title: Compact a conversation now (experimental)
description: The daemon sends Pi's own RPC compact to the conversation's running Pi. Pi chooses the cut itself (it always keeps about keepRecentTokens of the newest entries); the instructions only shape the summary.

request.description: POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/compact. Offered only while the agent waits for a message; a running turn is refused, never interrupted.

instructions.description: What the summary must keep, in the person's words; empty or absent leaves Pi's own summary prompt alone.

result.description: Pi's answer once its summary is written. A refusal is an error: 409 already_compacted or nothing_to_compact (Pi's own refusals), turn_running, compacting or cancelled; 404 when Pi is not running in the conversation (the browser wakes it and asks once more); 409 compaction_failed (Pi tried and failed; nothing changed); 503 control_uncertain (an uncertain outcome, never repeated).

estimated_tokens_after.description: Pi's heuristic estimate of the rebuilt context, not a measurement.
